notes.title: February 2nd Update Log
notes.content:
We have added a runtime log feature to the main menu, which will save the logs from your last 10 game sessions.

If you encounter any save file crashes, you can contact us immediately through QQ Group: 362056093. We will do our best to analyze the bugs in the save file and assist you in recovering it. We guarantee that it is highly likely to be recoverable—yes, it’s incredibly frustrating to crash right when you want to take a break after spending an hour in an endless run!

See you in the next update~

notes.title: Go To Kick
notes.content:
To be honest, we initially didn't plan to update during the New Product Festival; there’s still a lot we want to do, but time flies. However, after the festival began, our friends in North America reminded us that we needed to update the English version for them. So, we opened Youdao Dictionary and did a machine translation.

This led to some gameplay updates; we created corresponding skills for the first batch of eight characters. However, to keep things fresh, the demo only features two playable characters.

Now, everyone can choose from four difficulty levels to challenge themselves, and each character can select three unique talents in-game to continually enhance their abilities. Correspondingly, the variety of monsters has also increased (yes, we’re talking about you, Shell Monster).

We've also updated some items and weapons, but to maintain an air of mystery, we didn’t include them in this demo update. We still have more monsters, difficulties, and modes to create, and we hope we have enough time for all of this so we can see you in Q1 2025~

By the way, if you have any ideas or suggestions, you can join our QQ group: 362056093 to contact us.

Wishing everyone a great time playing!
2024.10.17
